<translated_code>
import sys
import math
import bisect

eps = 1e-8

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return abs(self.x - other.x) < eps and abs(self.y - other.y) < eps

    def __lt__(self, other):
        if abs(self.x - other.x) > eps:
            return self.x < other.x
        if abs(self.y - other.y) > eps:
            return self.y < other.y
        return False

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((self.x, self.y))

    def add(self, o):
        return Point(self.x + o.x, self.y + o.y)

    def sub(self, o):
        return Point(self.x - o.x, self.y - o.y)

    def rotate(self, alpha):
        c = math.cos(alpha)
        s = math.sin(alpha)
        nx = self.x * c - self.y * s
        ny = self.x * s + self.y * c
        return Point(nx, ny)

    def norm(self):
        length = self.length()
        return self.scale(1.0 / length)

    def scale(self, f):
        return Point(f * self.x, f * self.y)

    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"{self.x:.6f} {self.y:.6f}"


class Circle:
    def __init__(self, o, r):
        self.o = o
        self.r = r

    def contains(self, p):
        dist = p.sub(self.o).length()
        return abs(dist - self.r) < eps


class SortedSet:
    def __init__(self):
        self._list = []

    def add(self, point):
        i = bisect.bisect_left(self._list, point)
        if i < len(self._list) and self._list[i] == point:
            return self._list[i]
        self._list.insert(i, point)
        return point

    def __iter__(self):
        return iter(self._list)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self._list)


def intersect(c1, c2):
    dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x
    dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y
    d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    # Note: if d < eps, the following computation may produce NaN, but we keep original behavior
    cos = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d)
    if cos < -1 - eps:
        return []
    if cos < -1:
        cos = -1
    if cos > 1 + eps:
        return []
    if cos > 1:
        cos = 1
    alpha = math.acos(cos)
    dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm()
    p1 = c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha))
    p2 = c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha))
    return [p1, p2]


def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    circles = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(next(it))
        y = int(next(it))
        r = int(next(it))
        circles.append(Circle(Point(x, y), r))

    all_points = SortedSet()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            inter = intersect(circles[i], circles[j])
            for p in inter:
                all_points.add(p)

    point_id = {}
    adj = []
    for i in range(n):
        angle_set = set()
        K = 100
        for j in range(K):
            angle_set.add(2 * math.pi * j / K)
        for p in all_points:
            if circles[i].contains(p):
                dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x
                dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y
                alpha = math.atan2(dy, dx)
                if alpha < 0:
                    alpha += 2 * math.pi
                angle_set.add(alpha)
        angles = sorted(angle_set)
        dir_vec = Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r)
        for angle in angles:
            p = circles[i].o.add(dir_vec.rotate(angle))
            p = all_points.add(p)  # ensure we use the canonical point
            if p not in point_id:
                pid = len(point_id)
                point_id[p] = pid
                adj.append(set())
        for j in range(len(angles)):
            p = circles[i].o.add(dir_vec.rotate(angles[j]))
            q = circles[i].o.add(dir_vec.rotate(angles[(j + 1) % len(angles)]))
            u = point_id[all_points.add(p)]
            v = point_id[all_points.add(q)]
            if u != v:
                adj[u].add(v)
                adj[v].add(u)

    v = len(adj)
    e = 0
    for s in adj:
        e += len(s)
    e //= 2

    visited = [False] * v
    comps = 0

    def dfs(i):
        visited[i] = True
        for j in adj[i]:
            if not visited[j]:
                dfs(j)

    for i in range(v):
        if not visited[i]:
            comps += 1
            dfs(i)

    result = 1 + comps + e - v
    print(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
